stages.name: Fallen
stages.description: Demons mutter in their ears, and so the angels' halos are extinguished.

stages.name: Order
stages.description: When your calls, ignored for so long, suddenly receive a response, will you shudder with relief as your dreams are realized, or will everything feel... unreal?

stages.name: Strange Days in the Holy City
stages.description: If you are so used to the Holy City being an eternal, spotless white, then how would you ever notice the changes the sky casts onto it? < Dream Tiles > Operators deployed within will be pulled into the dream < Cosplayer > After awakening, helps out in battle by various means

stages.name: Prayer
stages.description: A miracle will befall this land when everyone believes that even the most fantastical dream can become reality. < Dream Tiles > Operators deployed within will be pulled into the dream

stages.name: Worship
stages.description: The dream has transformed our lives, and there are clues hidden within that allow us to recognize it. < Dream Tiles > Operators deployed within will be pulled into the dream

stages.name: Wayfinder
stages.description: The one finding a path forgot the road he walked in on, but he still believes the place he stands is his destined endpoint. < Dream Tiles > Operators deployed within will be pulled into the dream

stages.name: Enlightenment
stages.description: A new life, a new faith, a new future.

stages.name: Communion
stages.description: May our halos be shared. May our Lord share the blessings with all. < Dream Tiles > Operators deployed within will be pulled into the dream < Saint Statue Cosplayer > After awakening, provides DP and Deployment Limit

stages.name: Confess
stages.description: Those deep in dream return to reality, while errant angels return to their homeland. < Dream Tiles > Operators deployed within will be pulled into the dream < Shrine Marksman Cosplayer > After awakening, joins battle as an ally

stages.name: Funeral
stages.description: All walk toward the inevitable end. That is why the continuity of meaning is so precious. < Dream Tiles > Operators deployed within will be pulled into the dream < Shrine Marksman Cosplayer > After awakening, joins battle as an ally

stages.name: Pilgrimage
stages.description: The first Saint returns to the Holy City . The term " Sankta " is redefined. < Dream Tiles > Operators deployed within will be pulled into the dream < Shrine Marksman Cosplayer > After awakening, joins battle as an ally

stages.name: Interpretation
stages.description: The true face of the Law was nothing like what His faithful, His guardians, or His questioners imagined. < Dream Tiles > Operators deployed within will be pulled into the dream < Shrine Nurturer Cosplayer > After awakening, speeds up Operator awakening and replenishes SP and ammo

stages.name: Birth
stages.description: The infant severs the umbilical cord connecting it to God, determined to be born as a human—with all the ugliness, transience, and suffering that entails. < Dream Tiles > Operators deployed within will be pulled into the dream < Cosplayer > After awakening, helps out in battle by various means

stages.name: Reunion
stages.description: When the newborn Sankta meet the Law once more, it will take many years for the two to mend the voids in one another.

stages.name: Voyage
stages.description: We pray for the future. We walk towards our destined reunion... We are not alone.

stages.name: Garden of the Sankta
stages.description: An ecological park on the lower levels of the Shrine of Nurtury . The myriad creatures here hail from deserts, jungles, seas, and mountains, but they have all become Sankta. < Dream Tiles > Operators deployed within will be pulled into the dream

stages.name: Hall of Sweet Dreams
stages.description: A nursery on the lower levels of the Shrine of Nurtury . Every night, ten million children fall into dream here. Their shared dream melds together in the air, enough to ensnare anyone awake. < Dream Tiles > Operators deployed within will be pulled into the dream < Cosplayer > After awakening, helps out in battle by various means

stages.name: Dining Hall of the Saints
stages.description: A dining hall on the lower levels of the Shrine of Nurtury . As it takes several hours for the food to reach the upper levels, the Shrine's chefs have developed the most advanced techniques on Terra to keep food fresh. < Dream Tiles > Operators deployed within will be pulled into the dream < Shrine Marksman Cosplayer > After awakening, joins battle as an ally

stages.name: Fowlbeasts' Perch
stages.description: A balcony on the middle levels of the Shrine of Nurtury . Above the sea of clouds, it provides migratory fowlbeasts a place to rest on their journey. They arrive with drab feathers, and leave with halos of light. < Dream Tiles > Operators deployed within will be pulled into the dream < Shrine Marksman Cosplayer > After awakening, joins battle as an ally

stages.name: Saint's Prayer Room
stages.description: A region on the middle levels of the Shrine of Nurtury , where the Matriarch contemplates. Here, statues of every Saint in the history of Laterano stand. They hang their heads towards the "Matriarch" in prayer. < Dream Tiles > Operators deployed within will be pulled into the dream

stages.name: Distillery of Faith
stages.description: A functional structure on the upper levels of the Shrine of Nurtury . The countless prayers the Holy City hears every day converge here, and after flowing through the tangle of piping, they are distilled into a false sky. < Dream Tiles > Operators deployed within will be pulled into the dream

stages.name: The First Nursery
stages.description: A functional structure on the upper levels of the Shrine of Nurtury , the very first nursery built here. The Shrine, grand as it is, began as a thought, a simple cottage. < Dream Tiles > Operators deployed within will be pulled into the dream < Shrine Nurturer Cosplayer > After awakening, speeds up Operator awakening and replenishes SP and ammo

stages.name: "Puzzle of Laterano"
stages.description: Looking down from the Shrine 's peak up above the clouds, the city of Laterano looks like a miniature jigsaw puzzle. The "Matriarch" need only move her finger, and the appearance of the entire city will change. < Dream Tiles > Operators deployed within will be pulled into the dream < Cosplayer > After awakening, helps out in battle by various means

stages.name: Dessert Expo
stages.description: The fruits of Lateran passion, adoration, and ingenuity—an immense spread of innovative desserts—are displayed at the annual dessert expo in explosive fashion. < Dream Tiles > Operators deployed within will be pulled into the dream < "Gelato Stop" > Both allied and enemy units will fight for control over this device; When activated, restores SP of surrounding allies

stages.name: Preaching Drill
stages.description: Sermons directed at the unfaithful are never going to be put to use in a cozy church. The Curia conducts preaching training sessions so that the preachers will learn how to work their craft even in the most extreme environments. <Condition> DP will not regenerate naturally. < Dream Tiles > Operators deployed within will be pulled into the dream < Saint Statue Cosplayer > After awakening, provides DP and Deployment Limit

stages.name: Nationwide Parade
stages.description: Today, every Sankta will pick up their patron firearms with pride and walk along the streets. Their minds are fixed on joining the parade, where empathy ensures they will march in sync. < Dream Tiles > Operators deployed within will be pulled into the dream

stages.name: Summit of Nations
stages.description: The arrogant who once sneered at the Summit of Nations for being unworthy of the name now regret not having a way to atone. < Dream Tiles > Operators deployed within will be pulled into the dream < Shrine Marksman Cosplayer > After awakening, joins battle as an ally

stages.name: Sacrament of the Law
stages.description: The first Saint of Laterano did not arise from any ceremony, but it is she who bestows divinity onto every Lateran rite. < Dream Tiles > Operators deployed within will be pulled into the dream < Saint Statue Cosplayer > After awakening, provides DP and Deployment Limit
